messages:
morgan: Quick kickoff for the external pen test next Wed — need to lock RBAC change window, KMS access plan for assessors, and audit-log export procedure. Who can own the temporary-role and evidence upload flow?

sam: I can take temporary roles. Planning to create timeboxed IAM roles in staging + prod read-only. Will need a review for key wrap permissions. :+1:

alice: For KMS, we should avoid handing out raw key access. Suggest using an assessor proxy that can CreateGrant + GenerateDataKey without exposing key material. Will draft a key policy.

nate: Re: audit logs — do we want to provide raw SIEM access or periodic exports? Exporting to a presigned S3 path is simplest for assessors. We should add a hash manifest and retention note.

morgan: Good call. Sam, can you propose role ARNs and TTL? Alice, can you post the KMS policy snippet we plan to use? Nate, we'll want both live streaming (CloudWatch/Stackdriver) and a snapshot export for evidence.

sam: Draft roles: `arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/pt-assessor-readonly-prod-ttl-72h` and `...-staging-ttl-72h`. TTL enforced by automation that revokes after 72h. I can open PR for the revoke lambda.

alice: KMS policy draft (short):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/pt-assessor-proxy"},"Action":["kms:CreateGrant","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],"Resource":"*","Condition":{"Bool":{"kms:GrantIsForAWSResource":"true"}}}
  ]
}
```

claire: We should also require MFA and JIT approval for any role that gets elevated. Can the revoke lambda also post to #eng-oncall when roles are issued? ops-scheduler can handle JIT approval links.

ops-scheduler: I can create a JIT ticket flow. Proposed flow: 1) Assessor requests via /request-pt-access -> 2) approver gets ephemeral approve link -> 3) role issued for configured TTL -> 4) revoke job runs at TTL. I can add calendar blocks for retest windows.

nate: On audit exports: run a daily CloudWatch Logs Insights query for the last 48h and dump to S3 with `aws logs start-query` -> `aws logs get-query-results`. Add `X-Redwood-Manifest` file with sha256 of the tarball. Also include talk track for data residency (EU vs US).

morgan: Nice. Also need an evidence upload checklist for assessors: list of required logs (api-server, inference runtime, kube-audit, key-usage logs), filter windows, and schema for evidence manifest. Can someone stub that?

sam: I'll stub checklist and put in a doc. Minimal fields: service, logfile path, time range, hash, notes, correlation-id.

alice: Two more things: 1) Ensure KMS key rotation won't block decrypt during retest (we should schedule rotation off-window), 2) Ensure CloudTrail log file integrity validation is enabled so assessors can verify.

morgan: Agreed. For vuln triage: any findings from last internal scan that overlap with PT scope should be tagged `pt-priority` and moved to remediation board. Who will own triage during the assessment?

claire: I can Triage during hours 9-5 PT, and Nate can cover after-hours oncall for urgent P1s. We'll use the existing vuln tracker: https://tools.redwood/vuln-board/PT-2026 (please don't share outside).

nate: If something looks like active exploit, escalate to incident response channel: #incident-floor and follow IR runbook `ir/runbooks/active-exploit.md`. We should pre-authorize a containment play for the assessors if they need to demonstrate.

morgan: Last bit — retest coordination. Ops-scheduler, can you propose 3 retest slots in the two weeks post-fix? Try to avoid major deploy windows (we've got big infra deploy on Fri).

ops-scheduler: Will propose: Tue 09:00-12:00, Thu 14:00-17:00, Mon 18:00-21:00 UTC. I'll send calendar invites and set the channel reminders.

sam: I'll open the PRs for roles + revoke lambda today. Tagging @alice for KMS review and @claire for triage playbook review.

alice: Reviewing tonight, will post comments inline.

morgan: Thanks all — next actions: sam PR, alice KMS policy review, nate audit-export script, ops-scheduler retest slots + JIT flow. We'll run a dry-run (role issue + revoke) on Fri. :white_check_mark: 

infra-bot: deployment scheduled: `revoke-lambda` will run dry-run at 2026-04-03T16:00:00Z (no production changes).

claire: LGTM, leaving notes on the triage board and making a short runthrough doc for assessors with required evidence format.

morgan: Awesome — closing thread, will post summary doc later. If anything urgent ping me or #eng-oncall. :lock:
